title: Affine restriction comparison is epic
statement: Under the hypotheses of the affine coimage-image comparison, the restriction of its level n component to an affine open is an epimorphism.

proof.text: Write the affine open as Spec of its global sections. Transport its ideal and coherent formal category along isoSpec using the scheme-isomorphism equivalence. Map the ideal through ΓSpecIso and back to recover the transported ideal, then apply the affine equivalence. Noetherianity of the adic completion makes the finite-module category abelian. Finite products transfer along the equivalence, so Mathlib abelianOfEquivalence supplies abelianness on this one affine open, without any global abelian assumption.

The full-subcategory inclusion preserves cokernels by ambient cokernel closure. Termwise module restriction preserves cokernels, hence the composite of formal restriction with the target full-subcategory inclusion preserves them. That fully faithful inclusion reflects colimits, so formal restriction preserves cokernels. This is proved as a private helper using preservesColimit_of_reflects_of_preserves.

Apply open-restriction kernel preservation to alpha and its cokernel projection, and the preceding cokernel-preservation helper to alpha and its kernel inclusion. Mathlib PreservesCoimageImageComparison.iso identifies the restricted comparison with the coimage-image comparison in the affine formal category. The latter is invertible by its transferred abelian structure, so the former is invertible for the originally supplied global kernel and cokernel choices.

Apply the functor consisting of the affine full-subcategory inclusion and evaluation at op n. Functors preserve isomorphisms; its image is definitionally the stated restricted component, and every isomorphism is an epimorphism. This includes the empty affine open, zero arrows, and zero and unit ideals.

lean.statement: theorem coherentFormalModules_coimageImage_isEpi_restrict_affine (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] (I : X.IdealSheafData) [HasKernels (CoherentFormalModule X I)] [HasCokernels (CoherentFormalModule X I)] (U : X.affineOpens) {F G : CoherentFormalModule X I} (α : F ⟶ G) (n : ℕ) : Epi ((Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor (U : X.Opens).ι).map ((Abelian.coimageImageComparison α).hom.app (op n)))
